Coca-Cola's gross margin in fiscal Q4 2023 was **about 57%**. This is an estimate: I derived it from remembered figures rather than taking it from the filing, so it could be off by roughly a percentage point.

I worked it out by subtracting the first three quarters from the full year:

| | Net operating revenue | Cost of goods sold |
|---|---|---|
| Full year 2023 | ≈ $45,754M | ≈ $18,520M |
| Q1–Q3 2023 | ≈ $34,905M | ≈ $13,854M (approximate quarterly figures) |
| **Q4 2023** | **≈ $10,849M** | **≈ $4,666M** |

- Q4 gross profit ≈ $10,849M − $4,666M ≈ $6,183M.
- Q4 gross margin ≈ $6,183M ÷ $10,849M ≈ 57.0%.
